content: आवह {%a.%} (As last member of <ab>comp.</ab>) Producing, leading or tending to, bringing on; क्लेशावहा भर्तुरलक्षणाऽहम् <ls>R. 14. 5</ls>; so दुःख˚, भय˚, क्षय˚ <ab>&c.</ab> .{@-हः@} .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of one of the seven winds or bands of air, usually assigned to the भुवर्लोक or atmospheric region between the भूर्लोक and स्वर्लोक. .²2 One of the seven tongues of fire.
